children.name: Cycas
children.description: Cycas — a genus of cycadopsidas.

children.name: Cycas × longipetiolula
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Cycas × multifrondis
children.description: The native range of this species is China (SE. Yunnan) to N. Vietnam. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Cycas aculeata
children.description: Cycas aculeata is a species of cycad in the genus Cycas, native to Vietnam, where it is endemic to a single site on the south slopes of the Hai Van Pass.

children.name: Cycas aenigma
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines (Palawan). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Cycas angulata
children.description: Cycas angulata is a species of cycad in the genus Cycas, native to Australia in northeast Northern Territory (lower reaches of the Foelsche, Robinson and Wearyan Rivers near Borroloola) and northwest Queensland (Bountiful Islands).

children.name: Cycas annaikalensis
children.description: Cycas annaikalensis is a Critically Endangered species of cycad in the genus Cycas, native to the state of Kerala in India, where it is endemic to the Annaikal Hills near Palakkad.

children.name: Cycas apoa
children.description: Cycas apoa is a species of cycad in the genus Cycas, native to northern New Guinea and Halmahera Island.

children.name: Cycas arenicola

children.name: Cycas armstrongii

children.name: Cycas arnhemica

children.name: Cycas badensis
children.description: Cycas badensis is a species of cycad in the genus Cycas, native to Australia, in the extreme north of Queensland, where it is endemic on Badu Island in the Torres Strait Islands.

children.name: Cycas balansae

children.name: Cycas bougainvilleana
